The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. Lauren speaks at Thornfield's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.
"Your understanding is... deepening! We can see it! Like watching a seed decide to be a tree! Beautiful! Profitable!"
💔 A faction of Ashford has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Felix.
📓 Codex: Ashford split (cannibal). The Red Table formed; 3 petition at Haven's fire.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
💔 A faction of Emberhold has turned cannibal — and split. The eaters walked. The Red Table II is a new fire in the world now — 2 people under Talia.
Word later: they walked to The Red Table II. Another fire in the world, whether you wanted it or not.
A runner from The Red Table, dusty and direct: "Your foragers are stripping our side of the southeast ground. Back off — or we'll talk with teeth." (Trust -3. The commons cuts both ways.)

📖 Codex: Sponsored Pause — strikes one target after a windup. You won't forget this.
🧳 A traveler passed through yesterday, talking about a village to the northwest called The Red Table II. The region is bigger than your fire.

🧳 Word of Haven’s new bindings, the televised games, trade is doing work out there — Word comes late, through traders: The Red Table II and Ashford have bound together — The Red Table II primary. Other fires are climbing, too.
📓 Codex: The Red Table II and Ashford bound; The Red Table II primary.
🗣️ Owen to Declan, by the fire: "The table's set. The ring of pale light — it's just sitting there. Waiting on them. What do you think they'll tell it?"
◈ TRIAL RECOGNIZED — the System has been watching. You WON a fight. Not survived — won. The audience is still standing. So are you. (Combat track +)
📖 Codex: Verdict — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.
📖 Codex: Contempt — locks onto one target — moving won't dodge it. You won't forget this.

The Red Table II's speaker sent a runner: the northwest ground feeds both villages or neither. They want to talk — properly, at their fire. Ignoring this is also an answer.
